stated: Finally hold Government Ministers to account for corruption and sleaze by enshrining the Ministerial Code in legislation. Make the role of the Adviser on Ministers’ Interests truly independent by: Empowering them to initiate their own investigations, determine breaches and publish their report. bearing_set.reason: Enshrining the Ministerial Code in statute and making enforcement genuinely independent converts an unenforceable convention into a legal obligation — a direct rule-of-law and democratic-accountability measure falling within O9's scope of due process and democratic rights.

membership_note: This is a constitutional-accountability policy whose entire mechanism runs through O9 (rule of law, due process, democratic rights). It does not materially move O5 (no safety/crime effect), O10 (no citizen-liberty dimension), O12 (no fiscal mechanism), O15 (institutional trust is too indirect from community-cohesion indicators to clear the non-negligible bar), or any other fundamental.
